title: Edit external record link
purpose: Correct a link's label or address, with a reason that is kept in its history.
summary: Correct the label or address of a link and say why. The system, record type and identifier cannot change. A person-level link can be edited only with the Can view patient information permission.

tasks.title: Correct a label
steps: Change the [[Label]] and write the [[Reason for change]].

tasks.title: Add or fix the address
steps: Enter an https link in [[Address]], give the reason and save.

tasks.title: Fix a wrong identifier
steps: Remove the link from the ticket with a reason, then add the link again with the correct identifier.

good_to_know: The label and address are shared by every ticket and organization that carries this link.
A reason is needed, and a save with no change is refused. For a person-level link it is chosen from a list.
A person-level label must still not contain the whole key, an email address or more than eight digits in a row.
If someone else changed the link after you opened the form, saving is refused and your input stays.

items.label: Label
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters. What staff see. For a person-level link it must pass the masked label rules: no whole key, no email address, no more than eight digits in a row.

items.label: Address
items.description: Optional https link to the record, up to 500 characters, with no user name or password. Only for a system with a base address, and on that host. Never for a patient, participant or donor link. Not shown for a person-level link.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Required. Kept with the change in the history. For a person-level link the reason is chosen from a list (Wrong person, Entered in error, No longer needed, Other) and the history records only that choice.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Saves and returns to the link's page. The change is audited with the person, time, reason and the values before and after. For a person-level link the history names which fields changed and never their values.

items.label: Changed by someone else
items.description: If the link changed after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload and review it.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the link's page without saving.

items.label: Access
items.description: Every staff role can edit a link that is not person-level. A person-level link needs the Can view patient information permission, and answers not found without it. The page of a person-level link is not cached.
